items.title: Infinite Machine Olto review: A strange ‘e-bike’ or an urban transportation revolution?

Not because it’s obscenely powerful or flaunts conventional safety, but just because it doesn’t fit the mold that we’ve grown accustomed to. That’s exactly what the Infinite Machine Olto is.
